## About this website

This is the personal academic and research website
of Samuele Bovo, Assistant Professor at the
University of Bologna, Italy.

The website provides information about research
activities, scientific publications, funded projects,
academic experience and scientific events.

It is a personal academic website and is not an
official institutional website of the University
of Bologna.

## Data controller

Samuele Bovo

Email: samuele.bovo@unibo.it

## Website hosting

This website is hosted through GitHub Pages.

GitHub may process technical information, including
IP addresses and connection logs, for hosting,
security and service operation purposes.

Further information is available in the
[GitHub Privacy Statement](https://docs.github.com/en/site-policy/privacy-policies/github-general-privacy-statement).

## Website analytics

This website uses Google Analytics 4 (GA4),
provided by Google, to understand how visitors
discover and interact with its content.

Analytics information may include:

- Pages visited
- Referral sources
- Approximate geographical location
- Browser and device information
- Navigation and engagement information
- Online identifiers

The purpose of this processing is to evaluate
website usage, scientific visibility and the
accessibility of academic content.

Analytics data are not used for advertising
or commercial profiling by the website owner.

The legal basis for optional analytics processing
is the visitor's consent under Article 6(1)(a)
of the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR).

Further information is available in the
[Google Privacy Policy](https://policies.google.com/privacy).

## Cookies

This website may use cookies and similar
technologies for the following purposes:

### Necessary cookies

These support essential website functionality,
including the storage of cookie consent preferences.

### Analytics cookies

Google Analytics may use cookies to distinguish
visitors and measure website interactions.

Analytics cookies are optional and are activated
only after the visitor has provided consent.

Visitors may reject analytics cookies without
affecting access to the academic content.

## Managing consent

Visitors can accept or reject optional cookies
through the cookie consent interface.

Consent can be withdrawn at any time through
the cookie preferences available on this website.

Cookies can also be managed or deleted through
the visitor's browser settings.

## Data retention and international transfers

Analytics data are retained according to the
retention settings configured in Google Analytics.

Google and GitHub may process information outside
the European Economic Area, subject to the
applicable data protection safeguards described
in their respective privacy policies.

## External links

This website contains links to scientific
publications, academic institutions, research
projects and external scientific platforms.

External websites are governed by their own
privacy policies.

## Data protection rights

Under applicable data protection legislation,
visitors may have the right to:

- Access their personal data
- Request rectification or erasure
- Restrict processing
- Request data portability, where applicable
- Withdraw consent
- Lodge a complaint with a supervisory authority

For privacy-related enquiries, please contact:

[samuele.bovo@unibo.it](mailto:samuele.bovo@unibo.it)

The Italian data protection authority is the
[Garante per la protezione dei dati personali](https://www.garanteprivacy.it/).

## Policy updates

This policy may be updated to reflect changes
in website functionality, analytics services
or applicable legislation.

Last updated: November 2026.
